text:
alex: heads up — deploybot scheduled cutover at 06:00 UTC tomorrow. canary ramp plan attached. need QA signoff + mobile SDK owners to ack. @deploybot what’s current preflight status?

deploybot: Deploy scheduled by @morgan for org/v2-cutover. Canary ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 30% over 30m. Preflight checks: schema, telemetry, client-compat run. Status: schema ok, avg latency +2ms, error budget healthy. Command: `deploybot status 9723456789`

morgan: ack. will hold at 10% if mobile errors > 0.5% or 5xx delta > 1.5x baseline.

priya: quick note — release notes updated: https://go/release/notes/9723. mobile SDK needs header normalize patch; we pushed patch yesterday. recommend wait for one more warmup cycle.

alex: can we add a client pinlist escape in case mobile SDKs misbehave? prefer a header-based pin: `X-API-Version: v1`

deploybot: Pin override supported. Use `deploybot pin add --header 'X-API-Version: v1' --reason 'mobile-safeguard'`. Can execute during rollout.

jamie: ops will monitor canary. set telemetry alert: `svc.apis.v1.errors.rate` and `sdk.mobile.header.mismatch` with 5m burnin

morgan: agreed. rollback criteria: sustained >0.8% client error for 10m OR 5xx spike >2x for 5m. Also auto-fallback to v1 on gateway if deploybot sees healthfail.

alex: who’s oncall at the 06:00 window? @sre-jamie?

sre-jamie: I’m oncall. will be present. :thumbsup:

priya: QA will do targeted prompt set for v2 semantics at 05:30 UTC. please don't shift the window earlier.

morgan: noted. will not advance. If anything, we'll pause at 2% and call an ops check.

alex: thanks. tagging product for release notes verify @product-team. last ask — export deploybot plan here for handoff? paste below

deploybot: Plan snapshot:

```
plan_id: 9723456789
start: 2026-05-01T06:00:00Z
canary: [2%,10%,30%]
hold_points: [2%,10%]
rollback: auto-fallback to v1 if healthfail
pin-escape: header X-API-Version:v1
telemetry-alarms: errors.rate, latency.p90, sdk.header.mismatch
```

Executed by: morgan

alex: perfect. i'll post to release channel and set the operator handoff 05:45 UTC."
